title: E-Commerce Website Template
summary: This is an E-commerce website template with certain functionalities using javascript.
body:
## What it does

Skylar is the storefront for a fashion brand. Shoppers can browse featured products and new arrivals, view promotions, open a product to see a gallery with size and quantity options, read the blog, and get in touch through a contact page with a map.

## How I built it

I built all six pages by hand with HTML and CSS, without a framework, to get a solid understanding of layout before moving to React. The layouts use Flexbox, and a media query adapts them for phones. Vanilla JavaScript powers the mobile menu, which opens and closes on small screens, and the product gallery, where clicking a thumbnail swaps the main image. Icons come from Font Awesome, and the site is deployed on GitHub Pages.

## What I learned

Structuring a multi-page site taught me how much repeated code (the header, footer and product cards) plain HTML creates, and why component-based tools like React exist. It also showed me the gap between a storefront that looks complete and one that works: the cart and forms need JavaScript state or a backend behind them. On Day 9 of my 30-day challenge I'm rebuilding it as a React store with a working cart.
